fields.Name: T91 - Cross-Domain Org to Member
fields.Description: Verifies an Organization record shows its related Members.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Organizations' entity via the sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click a row, then 'Open Full Record'. Scroll to the related-records sections and verify the related 'Members' section shows the members belonging to that organization (member rows, or a valid empty-state if it has none). You do NOT need to open an individual member's record — verifying the Organization's related Members section displays is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An Organization record full form is displayed
The related 'Members' section shows that organization's members (rows or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
